Eye Care Birmingham/1239.words: The quickest way: pick up a pair of glasses you already like the fit of and look at the inside of the left arm. You'll find three numbers printed there.

Eye Care Birmingham/1252.words: The width of one lens at its widest. This is the number that decides whether a frame looks too small or too big on you.

Eye Care Birmingham/1255.words: The gap between the lenses that sits over your nose. Too narrow and they pinch; too wide and they slide down.

Eye Care Birmingham/1258.words: The length of the arm, ear bend included. I can adjust this in person, so it's the least critical of the three.
